subject: Analyzing actigraphy data that is split to two different BIN files

messages.author: 50e7fd04e637a3a1
messages.subject: Analyzing actigraphy data that is split to two different BIN files
parts:
Hi all,

Due to the long time period of our experiment (30 days, with sampling frequency of 25Hz), we were forced to change the GeneActiv device one time in the middle of the experiment for each participant.  
I have two questions regarding this issue:
1. Is there any elegant way to concatenate the two BIN files of each subject prior to the analysis?
2. If not, Does the GGIR output won't be valid if I run it separately on the first and the second half of the experiment?

Thank you very much in advance!

Best,
Alon
